source: Payload shapes follow what Grafana sends to each service (docs/research/grafana-notifications-datapath.md section 1.4) and what the service's public API takes, from memory. No template was sent to the real service. Every template marked unverified needs a test message to a sandbox receiver before it is relied on. Values go into JSON only through the json or escape helper.

generic.summary: A small JSON object with the issue id, title, state, priority and link. The receiver must be written for this shape; it is not the Grafana alerts[] body.

oncall.summary: An Alertmanager-style body for a Grafana OnCall Alertmanager or Grafana Alerting integration URL.
unverified: That the OnCall integration accepts this reduced Alertmanager body is not confirmed; it accepts the full Grafana body.

prometheus-alertmanager.summary: A one-element array for POST /api/v2/alerts of an Alertmanager. Of little value once New Relic replaces the Alertmanager.
unverified: That the Alertmanager API accepts this array and resolves the alert without an endsAt time is not confirmed.
The format of issueClosedAtUtc is not documented; the Alertmanager needs RFC 3339.

opsgenie.summary: The Opsgenie alert API body (POST /v2/alerts). The API key goes in the Authorization header as GenieKey <key>.
unverified: Atlassian publishes a New Relic template for Opsgenie that was not read; this body is built from the public alert API.
Closing the alert when the issue closes needs a second request to /v2/alerts/<alias>/close and is not done.

victorops.summary: The Splunk On-Call REST endpoint body. The integration and routing key are part of the URL.

url.secret: the path of the REST endpoint URL, from integrations/ to the routing key

unverified: Splunk links a New Relic template that was not read; the fields are those Grafana sends.

discord.summary: A Discord webhook message with one embed. The webhook URL holds the secret.

url.secret: the webhook id and token after /api/webhooks/

googlechat.summary: A Google Chat card message with a header and an open-issue button. The webhook URL holds the secret.

url.secret: the space, key and token after the host

unverified: Grafana sends a legacy cards message; whether the space accepts it (not cardsV2) was not checked.

telegram.summary: A Telegram sendMessage body. The bot token is part of the URL path.
unverified: Grafana sends form fields; that the Bot API accepts this JSON body from New Relic is from memory.
The escape helper is assumed to escape for a JSON string.

webex.summary: A Webex message to a room. The bot token is a bearer token on the destination.
unverified: The escape helper is assumed to escape for a JSON string.

sensugo.summary: A Sensu Go event for the events API. The API key goes in the Authorization header as Key <key>.

url.secret: the rest of the events URL, <host>/api/core/v2/namespaces/<namespace>/events

unverified: The event body is not mapped in the research note; this one is built from the public events API.
The API may need PUT instead of POST; New Relic always posts.

kafka.summary: A Kafka REST proxy records body (API v2). The URL is the proxy's topic endpoint.

url.secret: the rest of the topic URL, <proxy>/topics/<topic>

unverified: Whether New Relic honours a Content-Type set in the channel headers is not confirmed.
The format of the channel headers property is not documented.

dingding.summary: A DingTalk robot link message. The URL carries the access token.

wecom.summary: A WeCom robot markdown message (robot mode only). The URL carries the robot key.
unverified: The escape helper is assumed to escape for a JSON string.
